messages:
kevin: Heads-up — ACME asks for dual-custody HSM POC. Requirements: 2 independent custodians, key-splitting (shards), automatic daily rotation, dry-run cutover, and audit log export for SOC2. Also asked: impact on pricing & SLA.
rachel: Thanks. Do they need on-prem HSM or cloud BYO-HSM? That changes network/firewall and runbook. @kevin any vendor preference?
kevin: They prefer cloud HSM (CloudHSM-like) but want isolated appliance in their VPC. They also asked for a failover dry-run during business hours and a night window for rotation.
omar: Security notes: dual-custody means we need separation of duties + KMS policy enforcement. We'll require key-escrow audit steps and attestation for the POC. Also need answers for sec questionnaire items 3.2/4.1 about rotation frequency and split-key handling.
tia: Ops: dry-run logistics — recommend a staged runbook: prep -> escrow export -> shard reassemble -> validate tokens -> rollback plan. I can draft runbook. Need estimated ops hours (2 engineers, 4h dry-run, 8h prep) — counts as billable POC work unless covered by credits.
kevin: Pricing ask: do we bill POC ops hours + dedicated instance day rate? What about ingest/egress for audit logs?
rachel: Proposal: include 16h of engineering support as SOW line item + dedicated HSM day rate for the reserved window. Audit log export bandwidth is negligible but will show up on network egress invoice — we can cap it in the SOW.
omar: Also call out pen-test requirement: they want an independent attestation after POC. We should add a clause: pen-test coordination + remediation window (30 days) — cost estimate separate.
tia: For automation, we can provide this helper snippet for the dry-run orchestration:
```bash
# pseudo
redwood-hsmctl export-shard --key-id K123 --shard 1 --out /tmp/shard1
redwood-hsmctl import --shard /tmp/shard1 --to-test-vault
```
Runbook will include rollback commands.
kevin: Great. Customer also asked for SLA tweak: 99.95 for POC and 99.99 for GA. Is that negotiable?
rachel: POC SLA can be softer (no credits) but we can promise response SLAs. GA SLA 99.99 should be in enterprise contract with dedicated capacity + monitoring add-on.
omar: Security questionnaire snippets I'll send: rotation policy (daily/weekly options), custody model diagrams, attestation template. @kevin I'll need their legal contact for the pen-test clause.
kevin: I'll get legal contact. Next steps: rachel to draft SOW lines and quote, tia to draft runbook and ops estimate, omar to prep sec Qs and attestation template. Schedule dry-run tentatively week of 3/22. :thumbsup: 
devops-bot: ticket #PROS-1427 created for POC ops & billing
kevin: thanks — pinging back once I have customer's legal and preferred dates.
